subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw expose per-agent plugin installation before scoped uninstall, lifecycle lookup, and runtime/isolation semantics are complete?
rationale: This PR changes public CLI and persisted plugin config, and the safe product boundary depends on maintainer intent for install identity, runtime activation, update/uninstall cleanup, and plugin trust semantics.

options.title: Complete scoped lifecycle first
options.body: Require the PR to implement the full install/uninstall/update/inspect/registry contract before merging the new public flag.

options.title: Pause behind the design issue
options.body: Keep #97749 as the canonical product/security design item and close or park this branch until the contract is settled.

options.title: Accept an install-only experimental surface
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally ship the partial surface with explicit limitations and docs, but users would still face unmanaged scoped records and global runtime semantics.

recommendation.title: Complete scoped lifecycle first
recommendation.body: Require the PR to implement the full install/uninstall/update/inspect/registry contract before merging the new public flag.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and blame put this owner closest to the plugin lifecycle readers and registry behavior that must agree with the new scoped install identity.
